svg.text: FirstMate on Antigravity in T3 Code: where supervision waits
Between two turns, before and after this change.

g.text: Before
The turn ends and Antigravity runs
the Stop hook, which waits for the
next wake inside the hook
T3 still sees the turn running:
"Thinking" between turns, and each
wake arrives inside that same turn
after 15 quiet minutes T3's bound
for Antigravity fails the turn and
replaces the agent
After
The Stop hook hands the wait to one
detached waiter and the turn ends
at once
T3 shows FirstMate idle; the waiter
spans the captain's turns and spends
no model turn while the fleet is quiet
a real wake is rung into FirstMate's
own thread as a FirstMate doorbell;
if that fails, the old wait takes over

svg.text: Outside a T3 Code thread nothing changes: Antigravity in its own terminal still waits inside the Stop hook.
